body_html:
Redoing #edu106 for this semester. Began first by surveying students.

Broken into four elements: tell your story, learn something, teach something, do something.

 

There will be five tech tracks: web literacy, photo, audio, video, and data science. 

 

Web literacy will span the course but foljs will get two week primer on other tracks and then choose one for thier do something project and specialize.

 

The do something will last three weeks and revolve around a self or community improvement class. 

 

Gonna try to build entire class on existing #oer. 

#teaching #instructionaldesign
